visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a dense forest with tall, slender grey trees, a man wearing glasses, a leopard-print cloth draped over one shoulder, and a matching headband crouches while holding a primitive-looking spear with a large metal head. He looks cautiously to his right as the bright natural sunlight filters through the green canopy onto the leaf-strewn ground. (2) A person dressed in a full tiger-print onesie with ears is seen crawling on the leaves in the background. The man in the leopard skin notices the figure and assumes an aggressive defensive stance, pointing his spear towards the crawling tiger person while making an exaggerated facial expression of surprise. (3) The forest scene begins to glitch and distort with digital artifacts and scan lines. A man in a real-world indoor office setting, wearing a striped shirt and blue jeans, pulls off a white VR headset and controllers. He looks frustrated as he stands up from his black gaming chair. (4) The man in the striped shirt is now leaning against a white doorframe in a hallway, complaining to another man seated in a messy office. The second man wears a grey t-shirt and glasses, looking back from his computer monitors surrounded by tech equipment and shelves. (5) A glowing white box on a set of drawers is revealed, containing the TP-Link Deco BE85 router. The man unboxes the sleek white cylindrical device, carefully plugs in a power cable, and sets it on a desk. Close-ups show the green indicator light on the base. (6) Back in the VR forest world, the man in leopard skin is fighting the tiger person again. Instead of a spear, he pulls out a black handgun and shoots, causing the tiger person to fall over. Red pixelated heart icons appear above them like a classic video game interface. (7) The man in the striped shirt stands against a blurred background, holding the white router and pointing at it while talking directly to the camera. He then demonstrates a speed test app on his smartphone, showing numerical data over 700 Mbps. (8) The camera follows him walking through a large office with multiple workstations and then outside onto a paved street. He shows his phone screen again, indicating that the signal strength remains full even far from the original indoor location.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A man with curly black hair wearing glasses. In 'game' scenes, he wears a leopard-print cloth and headband. In 'real life' scenes, he wears a black and white striped shirt and blue jeans.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A dense forest with many slender vertical trees; a messy office with multiple monitors, tech boxes, and a gaming chair; an outdoor urban street with a factory-like building in the distance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with soft environmental forest sounds and a whispery male voice speaking in a low, conspiratorial tone. Suddenly, a loud, high-pitched tiger roar sound effect plays, followed by the immediate start of a high-tempo, energetic electronic background track with a strong, driving drum beat. (2) Sharp, percussive 'whoosh' and 'impact' sound effects are heard as the characters engage in stylized combat. A digital glitching sound, resembling electronic stuttering and white noise, signals a transition between worlds. The music cuts out briefly, replaced by the natural, slightly echoey room tone of an indoor office space. (3) A male voice shouts from a distance with high volume and arousal, complaining about a internet failure. A second male voice responds in a casual, slightly annoyed conversational tone. The sounds of a headset being placed down and clothes rustling are audible as the character moves around the room. (4) A bright, shimmering 'magical' chime sound effect plays as the product is revealed. The background music returns, this time a steady, upbeat pop-electronic instrumental. The crisp mechanical sounds of unboxing cardboard and the 'click' of an ethernet cable being inserted are clearly foregrounded. (5) Rapid-fire gunshot sound effects occur during a sequence in the forest, followed by lighthearted cartoonish 'game over' SFX. The main narrator's voice becomes highly enunciated and professional, delivering a rapid promotional script with infectious enthusiasm over the continuous, rhythmic music track. (6) The narration continues with high clarity as the scene moves outdoors, where a low-level background wash of wind and distant urban traffic is heard mixed under the voice. The track concludes with a final product recommendation and a quick musical fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Conflict -> Solution -> Feature Evidence -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the TP-Link Deco BE85 Wi-Fi 7 router by demonstrating how it solves real-world gaming lag and connectivity issues through a humorous VR-to-reality narrative transition, followed by technical speed and range tests.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct naming of the product, unboxing, feature explanation, and performance demonstrations.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses a high-arousal comedy sketch to hook the viewer before transitioning into a standard product feature showcase. The use of speed test apps provides empirical proof for the promotional claims.
